# AITJE

> AITJE is a Dutch AI specialist in local AI, automation and smarter workflows. Proprietary AI products, consultancy, development, installation and support, with independence as our guiding principle.

Official website: https://aitje.com. This index covers all published English pages. Dutch is the original site language.

The situation determines whether local, external or hybrid AI is appropriate. AITJE can also arrange suitable infrastructure; customers do not need to already own a server.

## Prices and conditions

Hourly rate: €75. All prices exclude VAT.

AITJE Assistent: €499 (self-installation); €599 (with basic installation; regularly from €698). Introductory offer for Assistant and Coder for the first 100 paying customers. Availability will be confirmed in your quotation.

AITJE Coder: €699 (self-installation); €799 (with basic installation; regularly from €898). Introductory offer for Assistant and Coder for the first 100 paying customers. Availability will be confirmed in your quotation.

AI-scan: €395 (regular €495). Introductory offer for the AI-scan for the first 10 paying customers. Availability will be confirmed in your quotation.

Hardware, server rental, travel or on-site costs and additional configuration are quoted separately.

From initial enquiry to a working solution. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/services

AITJE helps IT companies and agencies with the research, development and management of AI solutions. You maintain the client relationship and stay in control. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/services/voor-it-bedrijven
- [Case studies](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/cases.md): AI in day-to-day work: searching through internal knowledge, linking work processes and developing software. Explore the applications and approach of AITJE. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/cases

- [Vision](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/vision.md): AITJE’s vision: Dutch organisations retain control over powerful AI in-house, without inadvertently becoming dependent on closed platforms. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/vision

Introductory price: €395, excluding VAT. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/services/ai-scan
- [Token management & optimisation: The right AI for every step. Lower costs per result.](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/services/token-management-en-optimalisatie.md): AITJE Maps out AI usage and costs for content, knowledge, images and code. Optimise subscriptions, models and workflows. Available as a standalone service or as a follow-up to the AI scan. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/services/token-management-en-optimalisatie
- [Advice and analysis: Got an AI question? Take the next concrete step.](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/services/advies-en-analyse.md): From AI enquiry to a workable plan. ‘AITJE’ examines architecture, models, costs, test cases and guardrails. Fixed hourly rate and hours agreed in advance. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/services/advies-en-analyse
- [Installation and setup: Your own AI environment. Delivered ready for use.](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/services/installatie-en-inrichting.md): AITJE selects and configures hardware, a server or GPU-VPS for your AI solution. This can also be done on existing hardware or your own hosting. Software, models and storage are ready to use. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/services/installatie-en-inrichting
- [Optimisation: Get more out of the AI you’re already using.](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/services/optimalisatie.md): AITJE to improve your AI workflow, chatbot or agent. Optimise skills, rules, reusable code, tool calls, knowledge bases, RAG and models in a targeted manner. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/services/optimalisatie
- [Safe use of AI: Greater control over your AI and your data.](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/services/veilig-ai-gebruik.md): AITJE Helps limit AI usage through anonymisation, role-based access rights for RAG, guardrails, human oversight and budget limits. Insight into data locations and retention policies. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/services/veilig-ai-gebruik
- [AITJE Custom — Bespoke AI: Everything to do with AI. Tailored to your work.](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/services/aitje-custom.md): Bespoke AI: workflows using n8n or Zapier, bespoke apps, agents and 3D/VR. AITJE helps you choose and build, with local or external AI and control over data and costs. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/services/aitje-custom

Included are service hours, models, prompts, skills, AI health check advice, and relevant analyses and workflow demonstrations. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/services/ondersteuning-en-onderhoud

## Case studies

- [Ten models. One team. Control and independence.](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/cases/chatgpt-of-codex-in-je-eigen-organisatie.md): AITJE set up a shared AI environment for a development agency, featuring Assistent, Coder and ten models to choose from. A shared token pool of €350 per month replaces nine subscriptions to €200. Model usage and token costs per task can be tracked via Asana. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/cases/chatgpt-of-codex-in-je-eigen-organisatie
- [350 clients. One central workspace.](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/cases/council-hub.md): Following a takeover, a marketing company’s client base grew from 150 to 350. AITJE brought together client data, tickets, projects, invoicing information and call transcripts in a central hub. Staff can search for and chat with their business experts, with access based on their role and AI integrated into an existing Mac mini. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/cases/council-hub
- [25 New game levels every week. With no external token costs.](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/cases/coder-game-in-24-uur.md): A marketing agency took over an existing mobile puzzle game but ran into difficulties when creating new levels. AITJE analysed the game, built a reusable level design system and linked AITJE Coder to Qwen on its own server. Now, the agency 25 creates new levels every week from a single assignment in OpenCode. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/cases/coder-game-in-24-uur
- [From technical drawing to 3D product model.](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/cases/3d-productmodellen-met-ai.md): AITJE built a workflow for a partner specialising in contact cables that converts product data and technical drawings from WordPress into 3D models. AITJE Coder controls Blender; Three.js makes the GLB files usable on the website. Following optimisation, API costs fell from approximately €9 to €0.11–€0.18 per product. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/cases/3d-productmodellen-met-ai
- [Your firm’s expertise. An assistant that works with it.](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/cases/documenten-doorzoeken-en-lakken.md): For an estate agency, AITJE linked Realworks, email inboxes and Google Drive to its own AI assistant. Staff chat with the knowledge relevant to their role. The website chatbot uses a separate, carefully selected knowledge base from the same environment. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/cases/documenten-doorzoeken-en-lakken
- [Hey Bob. An extra pair of hands in the workshop.](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/cases/spraak-naar-werkorder.md): AITJE, developed a voice-controlled application for a local garage that serves over a hundred customers a day. Six Android tablets connect mechanics to technical information, work orders and their administrative records – simply by asking. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/cases/spraak-naar-werkorder
- [6,900 Products enriched and translated in 7 hours](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/cases/productteksten-zonder-tokenkosten.md): AITJE built a workflow for a leading Dutch online shop specialising in chargers that supplements product descriptions with technical charging data, translates them for four markets and uploads them directly back into the CMS. Without any external costs per AI token. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/cases/productteksten-zonder-tokenkosten

## Knowledge centre

- [What is generative AI?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-generatieve-ai.md): Generative AI creates new content based on a prompt: text, images, music, video, 3D or code. What happens during the generation process, and how do you turn an interesting result into something useful for your work? Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-generatieve-ai
- [What is text generation using AI?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-tekstgeneratie.md): Text generation is the process of creating text using a language model. From draft emails and summaries to structured responses: the task and the available information determine the output. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-tekstgeneratie
- [What is image generation?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-image-generation.md): Image generation, or ‘beeldgeneratie’, enables AI to create new images or modify existing ones. A description or reference provides guidance; the model constructs the visual output. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-image-generation
- [What is music generation?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-music-generation.md): Music generation is the process of creating music using AI based on, for example, style, atmosphere, instruments or a sound clip. The model generates a musical composition which you can then listen to and edit. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-music-generation
- [What is speech and audio generation?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-spraak-en-audiogeneratie.md): With AI, you can convert text to speech and generate other sounds. How do text-to-speech, sound effects and transcription differ, and where do they fit into a practical workflow? Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-spraak-en-audiogeneratie
- [What is AI-powered video generation?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-videogeneratie.md): Video generation creates moving images from a description, an image or an existing clip. The model must not only produce attractive images, but also maintain continuity between successive frames. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-videogeneratie
- [What is 3D generation using AI?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-3d-generatie.md): 3D generation creates a digital spatial representation based on text or images. From concept object to textured model: the output is only usable when it is compatible with your design software and application. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-3d-generatie
- [What is code generation using AI?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-codegeneratie.md): Code generation allows a model to suggest, extend or adapt software code. The real value lies in the proposal fitting the existing project and being able to be implemented in a controlled manner. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-codegeneratie
- [How does generation work with diffusion models?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/hoe-werkt-generatie-met-diffusion-modellen.md): Many generative image models construct an image through successive steps starting from noise. What roles do the model, the prompt and the settings play during that process? Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/hoe-werkt-generatie-met-diffusion-modellen
- [AI generation locally or via an API?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/ai-generatie-lokaal-of-via-een-api.md): Text, images and other output can sometimes be generated on your own hardware or produced via an external model service. Which approach best suits your data, desired quality and intended use? Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/ai-generatie-lokaal-of-via-een-api
- [What are frontier models?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-zijn-frontier-modellen.md): Frontier models are at the cutting edge of what AI is currently capable of. What does that say about quality, and when do you really need such a model? Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-zijn-frontier-modellen
- [What are open-source AI models?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-zijn-open-source-ai-modellen.md): Open source, open weights and free access do not mean the same thing. Find out what you can download, customise and run yourself — and what rights you need to do so. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-zijn-open-source-ai-modellen
- [What are tokens in AI?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-zijn-tokens.md): A language model works with tokens: small building blocks of input and output. They help determine how much context fits, how long a response takes and what an API request costs. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-zijn-tokens
- [What is model routing?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-modelrouting.md): With model routing, a workflow selects which AI model will carry out a task. This allows you to combine local models and external APIs based on quality, data and costs. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-modelrouting
- [What is quantisation in AI models?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-quantisatie.md): Quantisation stores model data with lower precision. As a result, a model may require less memory, but the impact on speed and quality varies depending on the application. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-quantisatie
- [What is fine-tuning?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-fine-tuning.md): Fine-tuning further trains an existing model using targeted examples. When is this helpful, and when are a better prompt or document search function sufficient? Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-fine-tuning
- [What is tool calling?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-tool-calling.md): With tool calling, a language model can suggest calling a function. Your software retrieves data or performs an action, within the permissions you set yourself. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-tool-calling
- [What is MCP, the Model Context Protocol?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-mcp.md): MCP provides AI applications with a unified way of accessing tools and information sources. What does this make easier, and what do you still need to sort out yourself? Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-mcp
- [What are AI hallucinations?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-zijn-ai-hallucinaties.md): AI can provide a convincing answer that is factually incorrect. Learn how to recognise fabricated information and build applications that handle uncertainty more effectively. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-zijn-ai-hallucinaties
- [What is digital sovereignty?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-digitale-soevereiniteit.md): Digital sovereignty is about having control over your data, systems and choices. In the context of AI, this also encompasses model access, management and the ability to switch providers. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-digitale-soevereiniteit
- [What is ablation in language models?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-abliteration.md): Abliteration adjusts a model’s internal properties to reduce learned rejection behaviour. What does this change, and what does it not tell us about the quality? Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-abliteration
- [What are the weights of an AI model?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-zijn-model-weights.md): Weights are the trained numbers that determine how a model processes information. Find out how model weights, parameters and a downloadable model file are related. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-zijn-model-weights
- [What is KV-cache in an LLM?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-kv-cache.md): The KV cache stores intermediate results from a language model, so that it does not have to repeat as much work during text generation. This helps with speed, but also requires memory. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-kv-cache
- [What is a vector in AI?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-vector.md): A vector is an ordered sequence of numbers. In AI, such a sequence helps to represent, compare and retrieve information — for example, when searching by meaning. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-vector
- [What is a token factory?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-token-factory.md): A ‘token factory’ is a metaphor for infrastructure that produces AI output. What lies behind such a factory, and how does this relate to inference and costs? Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-token-factory
- [What is inference in an LLM?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-inference.md): Inference is the process of using a trained model to produce an outcome. In the case of an LLM, this involves processing input and then constructing a response. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-inference
- [What is a vision model?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-vision-model.md): A vision model processes visual information, such as photographs and document images. A vision-language model combines this with language to answer questions about an image. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-vision-model
- [What is a coding model?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-coding-model.md): A coding model is designed for tasks involving software code. It can assist with explanations, additions and modifications, but a functioning development environment also requires tools and tests. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-coding-model
- [What is a VC subsidy for AI services?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-vc-subsidy.md): Investors and temporary grants can finance growth before a service pays for itself. How might such a potential grant affect your view of AI costs? Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-vc-subsidy
- [What is loss-leader pricing in the context of AI?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-loss-leader-pricing.md): With loss-leader pricing, an offer is priced at a loss to attract customers. How does this differ from a temporary discount, finance options and predatory pricing? Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-loss-leader-pricing
- [What is predatory pricing, or price gouging?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-predatory-pricing.md): Predatory pricing refers to low prices that can exclude competition. Why is a cheap AI API not in itself evidence of such a practice? Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-predatory-pricing
- [What is vendor lock-in in AI?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-vendor-lock-in.md): Vendor lock-in occurs when switching suppliers becomes difficult or expensive. With AI, this dependency often lies in data, APIs, model behaviour and workflows all at once. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-vendor-lock-in
- [What is an LLM?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-llm.md): An LLM is a large language model that can understand, predict and generate text. It often seems intelligent, but the quality of the result depends heavily on context, model choice and how you use it. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-llm
- [What is edge AI?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-edge-ai.md): Edge AI means that AI runs close to the source of the data, for example on a device, server or local network. This allows you to work faster and often gives you greater control over privacy, continuity and costs. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-edge-ai
- [What is local AI?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-local-ai.md): Local AI means that AI runs within your own environment, for example on a local device, server or network. It is about having greater control over data, availability, costs and dependence on external AI platforms. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-local-ai
- [What is on-premises AI?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-on-premise-ai.md): On-premise AI means that AI runs on infrastructure managed by your own organisation or at your own premises. This can help with privacy, compliance, business continuity and control over systems. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-on-premise-ai
- [White-label hardware, AITJE software](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/white-label-hardware-aitje-software.md): White-label hardware with ‘AITJE’ software means that ‘AITJE’ selects suitable hardware and provides the software layer, configuration and AI functionality tailored to the application. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/white-label-hardware-aitje-software
- [What is RAG?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-rag.md): RAG is a method whereby a language model first retrieves relevant information from documents or a knowledge base before providing an answer. As a result, answers are often more specific, better substantiated and more useful for your own organisation. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-rag
- [What is context in AI?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-context.md): Context is all the additional information you provide to a model so that it better understands what you mean. Good context makes the difference between a generic answer and something that really suits your task, organisation or document. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-context
- [What is a context window?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-context-window.md): The context window is the maximum amount of information a model can process in a single interaction. This determines how much text, chat history or document fragments can be used at any one time. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-context-window
- [What is an AI agent?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-ai-agent.md): An AI agent is a system that not only provides answers, but can also take steps towards a goal. This includes retrieving information, making choices, using tools and carrying out a task partly automatically. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-ai-agent
- [What are embeddings?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-zijn-embeddings.md): Embeddings convert text into vectors so that systems can recognise pieces of information that are similar in content. They form an important foundation for semantic search and many RAG applications. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-zijn-embeddings
- [What is prompt engineering?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-prompt-engineering.md): Prompt engineering is the deliberate formulation of instructions to ensure a model produces useful output. It is not about tricks, but about clarity regarding the objective, context, tone, preconditions and desired format. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-prompt-engineering
- [What is an API?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-api.md): An API is an agreed method by which systems exchange data or functions with one another. It is the interface that allows software to communicate with other software without the need for manual copying and pasting. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-api
- [What is a webhook?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-webhook.md): A webhook is an automatic message sent from one system to another as soon as something happens. This allows you to trigger processes immediately without having to constantly check for new information. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-webhook
- [What is a backend?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-backend.md): The backend is the part of the software where processing, logic, integrations and data flows run behind the scenes, out of the user’s view. It is the technical layer that ensures an app or website can actually do something. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-backend
- [What is a front-end?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-frontend.md): The front end is the part of the software that users see and interact with directly. It encompasses screens, forms, feedback and interaction, and therefore relates to how user-friendly and intuitive a system is in practice. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-frontend
- [What is the cloud?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-cloud.md): By ‘cloud’, organisations usually mean software, storage or computing power made available via external infrastructure. This offers flexibility, but also involves decisions regarding data, dependency and management. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-cloud
- [What is a workflow?](https://aitje.com/llms/pages/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-workflow.md): A workflow is the fixed sequence of steps through which work, information and actions move through a process. Only once you have a clear understanding of your workflows can you truly assess where software, automation or AI adds value. Web page: https://aitje.com/en/knowledge/wat-is-een-workflow
